result.title: Parallelism-Aligned Pruning and Round-Aware Context Reuse for On-Device Multimodal Agents
result.summary: On-device multimodal agents are limited by two deployment mismatches: pretrained attention structures may not divide evenly across the compute cores of an edge accelerator, causing irregular partitions; and standard prefix caching keeps historical visual tokens in the persistent KV cache, whose capacity grows with the number of rounds. We present PARC, which combines parallelism-aligned structured pruning with lifetime-aware KV-cache reorganization. At the model level, it uses first-order Taylor importance and grouped-query-attention-aware selection to make attention dimensions divisible by the target core count while preserving the query-to-key/value ratio and head dimension. At runtime, it separates the system prompt, persistent text history, and transient visual observations by lifetime, updating text history during tool execution so that historical images leave the persistent cache and more interaction rounds fit a fixed budget. On 2,062 GUI actions, the incremental interface shows no accuracy regression, and task-aware recovery training restores 98.7% of the action-type accuracy gap and the coordinate hit rate to the original level. Under seven-core deployment, hardware-aligned pruning reduces vision-encoder latency by 11.4%, improves decoding throughput by 23.8%, and lowers per-heap high-water memory by 12.7%; a parameter-matched control confirms that the speedup stems mainly from core alignment rather than parameter reduction.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PARC，将注意力维度结构化剪枝到与边缘芯片核心数对齐，并按生命周期重组多模态 KV cache，把历史图像移出持久缓存，以降低端侧 GUI agent 的延迟与内存。
AI.relevance_reason: 按生命周期区分系统提示、文本历史与瞬时视觉观察的缓存组织方式，可能为多轮 LVR 中的视觉证据保留/淘汰与推理成本评估提供线索，但其本身不研究 latent 推理状态，需核查缓存淘汰对历史视觉信息可用性的影响。
